sections.title: 1. Introduction & Module Overview
sections.intro:
Inventory module hotel ka store aur purchase system hai — vegetables se lekar amenities tak, sab items ka stock track hota hai.

Analysis HMS me Inventory flow: Quotation/Indent → Purchase Order → Material Receive (MR) → Purchase Bill (stock in) → Requisition → Stock Issue (stock out) → Reports (register, summary, movement). Kitchen/Outlet consumption POS sale se recipe-based automatic deduct hota hai (Recipe Master ke through).

PURCHASE CYCLE (Training Flow):
Need identify → Indent → Quotations compare → PO issue → Material Receive → Purchase Bill entry → Payment (Finance) — aur consumption side: Department requisition → Stock issue → Stock reports

subsections.title: 2.1 Party Master (Vendors/Suppliers)
subsections.paragraph: Suppliers/vendors ki master — naam, address, GSTIN, payment terms, TDS category. Purchase Order aur Purchase Bill me yahin se party select hoti hai.

rows: Vendor type ke hisaab se TDS

subsections.title: 2.2 Item Group / Category / Item Entry
subsections.navPath: Main Setup ▶ Inventory ▶ Item Group / Item Category / Item Entry
subsections.paragraph: Items hierarchy: Group (Vegetables/Dairy/Cleaning) → Category (fine detail) → Item entry (code, unit, rate, min stock level, store). The raw items of the dish are defined in Recipe Master — for auto-deduction on sale.

rows: Item name, code, group/category, unit (Kg/Ltr/Pcs), min level, store
Item wise starting qty + rate (at the time of system start)
Dish → raw items + qty (1 plate Paneer = 200g paneer + 50g butter...)

subsections.title: 3.1 Quotation & Indent
subsections.paragraph: Quotation: Record the rates received from vendors (for comparison). Indent: department's requirement — how much item is required. PO is issued after indent is approved.

rows: Vendor, item, rate, validity — compare karne ke liye
Department, item, required qty, required date — approval workflow

subsections.title: 3.2 Purchase Order (PO)
subsections.paragraph: Issue PO with approved indent/quotations – print to send to vendor. The material has been received on PO (see PO reference in MR).
steps: PO screen kholo → vendor select karo
Indent se items load karo ya manually add karo
Rates verify karo (quotation ke hisaab se)

subsections.title: 3.3 M R Entry (Material Receive)
subsections.paragraph: Goods arrive at receive entry — receive qty against PO, check quality, note short/damage. This is the document of stock IN.

subsections.title: 3.4 Purchase Bill
subsections.caption: Purchase Bill entry screen
subsections.paragraph: Vendor ka actual bill entry — MR ke against bill amount, tax (GST input credit), sundry charges. Ye entry stock value + vendor liability (finance me payable) dono bana deti hai. Duplicate bill check bhi hota hai (same bill no. block).

rows: Bill ki identity — duplicate check hota hai
Extra charges landed cost me add

subsections.title: 3.5 Requisition Slip → Approval → Stock Issue
subsections.navPath: Inventory ▶ Operation ▶ Requisition Slip / Approved Requisition / Stock Issue
subsections.paragraph: Departments (Kitchen, HK, F&B) store se material maangte hain: Requisition Slip banao → store manager approve kare (Approved Requisition screen) → Stock Issue pe material issue ho jaye. Stock department wise consume ho jata hai.
steps: Requisition Slip — department, items, qty maango
Approved Requisition — store manager approve/reject kare
Stock Issue on Requisition — approved slip pe issue karo (stock out)

subsections.title: 3.6 Stock Transfer
subsections.paragraph: Send stock from one store/department to another — Main Store → Kitchen, or Kitchen → Bar. Qty is adjusted at both places (from minus, to plus).

subsections.title: 3.7 Kitchen Closing Stock Entry
subsections.paragraph: Physical count entry of night's closing stock in the kitchen — this is necessary to calculate daily consumption (Issue - Closing = Actual Consumption). Wastage/variance is thus tracked.

rows: How much is left physically in the kitchen?

subsections.title: 3.8 Gate Pass Exit (Security Control)
subsections.navPath: Inventory ▶ Gate Pass ▶ Gate Pass Exit
subsections.paragraph: Gate pass for goods going out from the hotel (repair, return, transfer) — this pass is checked at the security gate. No food comes without a pass.

rows: When will you come back (repair me)
Which item where issued — audit list
Date/vendor wise saari purchases — for GST input

subsections.title: 4.2 MIS Reports
subsections.paragraph: Stock Movement: item ka pura safar (receive → transfer → issue). Kitchen-wise Issue & Sale: kitchen me kya issue hua vs kitna bikaa — variance/wastage analysis. Ye food cost control ka core report hai.

rows: Issue qty vs sold qty — gap = wastage/theft check

subsections.caption: Gate Pass related screens
subsections.paragraph: Gate Pass Exit: Items to be taken out of the hotel (repair, return) — print pass for security check. Inward Details / Receiving Department: Record of the food coming from spring. These passes are checked at the security gate.
